description: Regional Bay Area terrain sources from Pacific water through Mount Diablo and Suisun Bay through Morgan Hill.

projected_envelope_derivation.tool: PROJ cs2cs 9.1.1, dense WGS84 perimeter sampling
projected_envelope_derivation.policy: Expand outward to complete native working-grid cells; never crop the requested WGS84 rectangle.

tile_policy.reason: Bound each request and retry independently, remain far below the 3DEP service 8000x8000 limit, and avoid one fragile regional export.

runtime_note: This manifest pins acquisition inputs only. It contains no mosaics, normalized derivatives, terrain meshes, or airport meshes.

validated_details.description: The USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) Bare Earth DEM Dynamic service is based on multi-resolution USGS DEM sources and provides dynamic functions for visualization. These functions include: Hillshade, Aspect Map, Hillshade Stretched, Multi-directional Hillshade, Slope Map, Elevation Tinted Hillshade, Contour. In addition the OGC Web Map Service (WMS) and Web Coverage Service (WCS) interfaces are enabled. Data available in this map service reflects all 3DEP DEM data published as of July 20, 2026.
validated_details.copyright_text: USGS National Map 3D Elevation Program (3DEP). July 23, 2026.

datasets.provider: U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map, 3D Elevation Program
datasets.product: 3DEP Bare Earth DEM Dynamic service resampled to a 10 metre working grid
datasets.vertical_datum: North American Vertical Datum of 1988 (NAVD 88), as reported by all intersecting non-overview source records
datasets.license_status: USGS public-domain data; no use restrictions stated by 3DEP

datasets.provider: U.S. Geological Survey EROS / Multi-Resolution Land Characteristics Consortium
datasets.product: Annual NLCD CONUS Collection 1.2 Land Cover, 2025
datasets.grid_alignment: Bounds are exact 30 metre multiples from native boundary origin (-2415585, 164805).

future_airport_layer_source.scope: Cross-reference only; airport data is not ingested as terrain and no airport mesh is generated by this acquisition.
future_airport_layer_source.canonical_start: KOAK runway end 28L; use the physical/displaced-threshold and surveyed-source semantics pinned by the authoritative airport manifest.
future_airport_layer_source.rendering_policy: Airport hard surfaces and markings are a separate streamable container/layer in ordinary solid-flat mode 1, initially self illuminated; they never use terrain dithering mode 2.
